personality: 6 Glass / Luxe DARK fused with 7 Dark-First Utility
personality_one_liner: An elegant, highly precise command center with cinematic glass overlays and a warm amber glow, treating 3D printing management like a high-end laboratory.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical breathing room for premium feel, tight metric grouping for utility. Intentional padding.

do's: Apply to bottom tab bar, floating actions, sticky headers over scrolling content.
Use on hero/feature cards sitting over background photos.
Always layer a translucent tinted base (>=75% surface opacity) underneath the glass for readability.
dont's: Never apply to form fields, body text, or standard list rows.
Do not over-blur so much that the underlying UI becomes illegible if it's meant to be seen.
Avoid on dense utility screens where high contrast is better.

screens.name: Início (Dashboard)
screens.purpose: High-level overview of daily revenue, active 3D printers, and quick access to pending jobs.

states.empty: No data yet. 'Add your first order' CTA.
states.error: Failed to load dashboard data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Vertical scrolling. Top section is a hero Glass card overlaid on an abstract 3D dark background, showing total revenue. Below, a 2-column grid of KPI metric cards (Active Printers, Pending Orders). Use strong typographic hierarchy for numbers.

screens.name: Orçamentos (Quotes)
screens.purpose: Professional calculator for estimating print costs and setting margins vs markups.
screens.layout: Single column form with clear labels above inputs. Tonal separation (surfaceTertiary) for cost breakdown results. Primary 'Calculate / Save' CTA is sticky at the bottom over a glass or solid fade.

screens.name: Pedidos (Orders)
screens.purpose: List of all sales and active client orders.

states.empty: Illustration of an empty box. 'No orders found.'

screens.layout: Pinned segmented control (Pending, Producing, Shipped) scrolling behind a glass header. List items are minimum 56pt height with order number, subtle status pill, and value.

screens.name: Mais (Hub)
screens.purpose: Menu gateway to all other modules (Produção 3D, CRM, Catálogo, Estoque, Compras, Financeiro, Relatórios, Configurações).
screens.layout: A 2-column grid of square cards (width: (screenWidth - 2*screenPadding - gap) / 2) with space-between. Each card has a tinted icon container (brandTertiary) and title.

screens.name: Produção 3D
screens.purpose: Manage the print queue per printer (Bambu Lab A1, A1 Mini).
screens.layout: Sticky horizontal tabs for each printer. Cards show job name, filament used, time left, and a progress bar. Include a hero image of the printer at the top under a glass fade.

screens.name: Estoque
screens.layout: Vertical list. Each row includes a small image of the filament spool, name, color dot, remaining weight, and low-stock warning if applicable.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the dark theme color palette using the warm amber accents. Absolutely NO blue, purple, or indigo anywhere.
Implement navigation using bottom tabs for 'Início', 'Orçamentos', 'Pedidos', and 'Mais'.
The 'Mais' tab is a hub screen containing a 2-column grid to route to the remaining modules (CRM, Catálogo, Estoque, Compras, Financeiro, Relatórios, Configurações).

In the Dashboard, use the 'dashboard_hero_bg' image as the background for the top revenue card. Ensure you apply the required vertical gradient scrim (transparent to >=75% surfaceInverse) to guarantee text contrast.
For 'Orçamentos', ensure the 'Calculate' CTA is sticky at the bottom of the screen (not lost inside scroll) using KeyboardAvoidingView and appropriate padding.
For the 'Produção 3D' screen, incorporate horizontal tabs (A1, A1 Mini) and utilize the 'printer_a1' image for visual context of the active printer.
All cards must span full width in 1-column layouts, or fill 2 columns completely without orphans (use flexWrap with space-between).
Include Skeleton loading states and explicit empty/error states on all data screens.
Use Phosphor icons consistently (filled for active tabs, outlined for inactive/general UI).
Implement glassmorphism on the bottom tab bar and sticky headers using expo-blur/expo-glass-effect.
